phonemizerEvidence.implementation: Pinned kokoro_onnx.tokenizer.Tokenizer() in approved .venv-tts; read-only calls to phonemize, no synthesis or file changes

recommendedActions.scope: 2327 speaking/takeaway-1; ideally every en-gb tearjerker clip
recommendedActions.action: Correct the audio-layer G2P for exact tearjerker lexeme to retain stressed /dʒɜːk/ as in tokenizer tear-jerker; version synthesis identity, regenerate only affected requests, rerun both ASR systems. Do not alter canonical spelling or mark listening approved.

Test a pinned audio-layer phoneme override that inserts a word boundary between quiet and hour while preserving displayed quiet-hour text; version/regenerate affected requests and rerun both ASR systems. Inspect exact target form before any canonical edit.

Inspect target-word acoustics or use a controlled resynthesis/ASR comparison before changing canonical text. Their pinned G2P is not obviously wrong; dual ASR alone cannot establish a synthesis defect.
Do not change content or regenerate solely for these flags. British/US spelling, homophones, and ASR word segmentation explain them more parsimoniously than a proved audio fault.

files.baseRecognised: The sponsor offered the committee a blank check to redesign the community hall.
files.smallRecognised: The sponsor offered the committee a blank check to redesign the community hall.
files.assessment: British cheque / US check spelling only; same pronunciation.

files.baseRecognised: A simple walking map made getting from A to be easier for new visitors.
files.smallRecognised: A simple walking map made getting from A to be easier for new visitors.
files.assessment: The letter B and be are homophones in this frame.

files.baseRecognised: The final reunion made the drama a Teijica for many viewers, although others stayed dry-eyed.
files.smallRecognised: The final reunion made the drama a Tijica for many viewers, although others stayed dry-eyed.
files.assessment: Both ASR models render tearjerker as Tijica/Teijica; pinned en-gb phonemizer weakens jerker to /dʒəkə/.

files.baseRecognised: Repeated timetable errors condense your credibility with the people, relying on your updates.
files.smallRecognised: Repeated timetable errors condense your credibility with the people relying on your updates.
files.assessment: Both ASR models return condense for dent your; pinned G2P has correct /dɛnt jɔː/. Other 2511 roles recognize the target.

files.baseRecognised: Once the archive building failed its safety inspection, our exhibition plan had gone out to the window, and we began looking for a temporary gallery.
files.smallRecognised: Once the archive building failed its safety inspection, our exhibition plan had gone out the window and we began looking for a temporary gallery.
files.assessment: Both omit weak of in out of the window, a common connected-speech reduction; another role recognizes full form. No definite defect.

files.baseRecognised: The questionnaire asked people to rank comfort, cost and style, making the importance they they attach to fashion easier to compare.
files.smallRecognised: The questionnaire asked people to rank comfort, cost and style, making the importance they attached to fashion easier to compare.
files.assessment: Both ASR models render attach as attached; final /t/ versus /tʃ/ needs a target-word check. Pinned G2P is grammatical attach.

files.baseRecognised: The club did not receive a blank check, every purchase needed approval.

files.baseRecognised: Families join the hunt for the lost dog by checking nearby parks.
files.smallRecognised: Families join the hunt for the lost dog by checking nearby parks.
files.assessment: Both ASR models omit past /d/ from joined before the; G2P contains /d/. Other 2410 roles recognize inflected target.

files.assessment: Both ASR models turn quiet-hour into quietower/choir tower; same joined phoneme sequence as takeaway.

limits: Both recognizers operated on the same clips and may share language-model biases. Signal decode checks do not test pronunciation. This report did not audition clips, change content, synthesize audio, or certify accent/listening.
